```yaml
name: Update compat-table

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-compat-table:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 'latest'
          run_install: false

      - name: Get latest compat-table SHA
        id: get_latest_sha
        run: |
          LATEST_SHA=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/compat-table/compat-table/commits/main | jq -r '.sha')
          echo "latest_sha=$LATEST_SHA" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Read current SHA from package.json
        id: read_current_sha
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(jq -r '.dependencies."@mdn/browser-compat-data"' tasks/compat_data/package.json | cut -d'@' -f2)
          echo "current_sha=$CURRENT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Compare SHAs and update if needed
        id: compare_and_update
        run: |
          if [[ "$CURRENT_SHA" != "$LATEST_SHA" ]]; then
            echo "SHA changed from $CURRENT_SHA to $LATEST_SHA"
            echo "sha_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            # Update package.json
            sed -i "s/\"@mdn\\/browser-compat-data\": \"[^\"]*\"/\"@mdn\\/browser-compat-data\": \"$LATEST_SHA\"/" tasks/compat_data/package.json
          else
            echo "No SHA change detected"
            echo "sha_changed=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies and build
        if: env.sha_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          cd tasks/compat_data
          pnpm install
          pnpm run init
          pnpm run build

      - name: Check for changes
        if: env.sha_changed == 'true'
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || echo "changes_detected=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.sha_changed == 'true' && env.changes_detected == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update compat-table to ${{ env.LATEST_SHA }}"
          title: "chore: update compat-table to latest commit"
          body: |
            This PR updates the compat-table dependency to the latest commit.
            
            - Old SHA: ${{ env.CURRENT_SHA }}
            - New SHA: ${{ env.LATEST_SHA }}
            
            This ensures oxc always has access to the latest JavaScript/TypeScript compatibility data.
          branch: update/compat-table-${{ env.LATEST_SHA }}
          base: main
          assignees: Boshen
          labels: chore
```
